name: OpenClaw Tool Output Normalizer
description: Normalize verbose tool outputs into concise, structured, model-friendly summaries.

maxStringLength.description: Max length for long text fields before truncation.

maxArrayItems.description: How many array items to keep as representative samples.

maxObjectDepth.description: Maximum object depth retained in normalized snippets.

maxExcerptLength.description: Maximum raw excerpt length in final output.

enableWarnings.description: Whether normalizers should emit warning hints for low-quality inputs.

preferredImportantFields.description: Preferred field names to prioritize in important_fields extraction.

webNoisePatterns.description: Case-insensitive patterns used to filter noisy web lines.

debug.description: Enable debug details in warnings for development.
